ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the left input terminal Ui of the comparator in the attached figure is connected to the inverting (−) input terminal; the non-inverting (+) input terminal is connected to a resistor voltage-divider node. This voltage-divider node is connected to the right-side output node Uo through R1=30 kΩ, and is also grounded through R2=30 kΩ. At the output node Uo, there is also a Zener diode connected to ground, and the problem gives the Zener value UZ=6 V. Reasoning: when finding the positive threshold +UT, according to the state before positive-direction switching, take the output node as being in positive Zener clamping, that is, Uo=+UZ=+6 V. The reference voltage at the non-inverting terminal is obtained by voltage division of R1 and R2: V+=Uo·R2/(R1+R2)=6×30/(30+30)=3 V. The comparator switches when the inverting-terminal input Ui reaches the reference voltage at the non-inverting terminal, therefore +UT=3 V.

raw_record.question_text: The voltage comparator circuit is shown in figure 27. The Zener diode has a stable voltage \(U_Z = 6V\), and its forward voltage drop can be ignored. The threshold voltage \(+U_T\) of the circuit is () V.

method.method_draft: Inspect the circuit: Ui goes to the − input, while the + input is connected to the midpoint of R1 = 30 kΩ and R2 = 30 kΩ between the output node and ground. For the positive threshold +UT, take the output node in its positive Zener-clamped state, Uo = +UZ = +6 V. The non-inverting input reference is the divider voltage: V+ = Uo * R2/(R1+R2) = 6 * 30/(30+30) = 3 V. The comparator changes state when Ui at the − input reaches V+, so +UT = 3 V.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图中的比较器左侧输入端 Ui 接到反相（−）输入端；同相（+）输入端接在一个电阻分压节点上。该分压节点通过 R1=30 kΩ 接到右侧输出节点 Uo，同时通过 R2=30 kΩ 接地。输出节点 Uo 处还接有稳压二极管到地，题目给出稳压值 UZ=6 V。推理：求正阈值 +UT 时，按正向翻转前的状态取输出节点处于正稳压钳位，即 Uo=+UZ=+6 V。同相端参考电压由 R1、R2 分压得到：V+=Uo·R2/(R1+R2)=6×30/(30+30)=3 V。比较器在反相端输入 Ui 达到同相端参考电压时翻转，因此 +UT=3 V。

method.method_draft: Treat the non-inverting input node voltage as an unknown Vref. For the positive threshold, set the output/Zener node to +6 V. Because the comparator input draws negligible current, write KCL at the + input node: (Vref - 6)/30k + (Vref - 0)/30k = 0. Solving gives 2Vref - 6 = 0, so Vref = 3 V. At the switching boundary, Ui on the − input equals this reference, therefore +UT = 3 V.
